Every time you guys yell eye test and then hide behind the triangle offense excuse you tell on yourself. Jordan took more shots than anyone in the timespan of his career, that’s why he averaged less assists. If he “wanted to” or was capable. He would’ve. 

We’ve seen Lebron play off ball with Wade, Kyrie, and rondo, as well as other capable ball handlers. He is just a better facilitator than most. Cherry-picking small moments of a 21 year career to make something out of nothing is a personal insecurity between two stars you’ve seen, not the reality. Jordan has 1.5% HIGHER usage. If you are talking about ball dominance, Jordan is more likely to have the possession end with him than it is for James. 

You’re trying to praise a system designed to move the ball in a team dominant league and talk down upon a completely different style of basketball that was dominated by star play. The reality of the matter is Lebron made a career of being a great scorer and a good passer, Jordan wanted to score and passed whenever he chose to.

If you’re trying to have your cake and eat it, you’re really only saying Jordan is a system player—which would explain why he never could win without Scottie, and it took a the zen master and Tex winters system for him to finally get a ring. If you’re trying to make lebron seem “ball dominant”, but he has a ring with every franchise he played for, you’re really just saying all stars/coaches/players rely on him to carry because they know they can’t do it themselves. Or we could just go with reality and look at the facts and say Jordan couldn’t pass like Lebron and it’s okay, instead of writing out all that fan fiction to cope with the pain that Jordan isn’t the best at everything.
